UPDATE reminder_log rl
SET status=CASE 
      WHEN rl.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN rl.status 
      ELSE 'SKIPPED' 
    END,
    last_error=CASE 
      WHEN rl.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN rl.last_error 
      ELSE 'Appointment is no longer SCHEDULED' 
    END,
    locked_at=NULL,
    updated_at=now()
FROM appointments a
WHERE a.id=rl.appointment_id
  AND rl.status='PENDING'
  AND rl.locked_at IS NULL
  AND a.status <> 'SCHEDULED'
RETURNING rl.id AS reminder_id;

INSERT INTO reminder_log (
  appointment_id, reminder_type, status, scheduled_for, attempts, last_error, locked_at
)
SELECT
  a.id, rt.reminder_type,
  CASE WHEN a.starts_at - rt.lead_interval > now() THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SKIPPED' END,
  a.starts_at - rt.lead_interval,
  0,
  CASE WHEN a.starts_at - rt.lead_interval > now() THEN NULL
       ELSE 'Reminder window was already missed when the reminder record was created' END,
  NULL
FROM appointments a
CROSS JOIN (
  VALUES
    ('THREE_DAY'::text, INTERVAL '3 days'),
    ('ONE_DAY'::text, INTERVAL '1 day'),
    ('FOUR_HOUR'::text, INTERVAL '4 hours'),
    ('ONE_HOUR'::text, INTERVAL '1 hour')
) rt(reminder_type, lead_interval)
WHERE a.status='SCHEDULED' AND a.starts_at > now()
ON CONFLICT (appointment_id, reminder_type)
DO UPDATE SET
  scheduled_for=EXCLUDED.scheduled_for,
  status=CASE 
    WHEN reminder_log.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN reminder_log.status
    WHEN EXCLUDED.scheduled_for > now() THEN 'PENDING' 
    ELSE 'SKIPPED' 
  END,
  attempts=CASE 
    WHEN reminder_log.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN reminder_log.attempts
    ELSE 0 
  END,
  last_error=CASE 
    WHEN reminder_log.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN reminder_log.last_error
    WHEN EXCLUDED.scheduled_for > now() THEN NULL
    ELSE 'Reminder window was already missed after appointment reschedule'
  END,
  locked_at=CASE 
    WHEN reminder_log.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN reminder_log.locked_at
    ELSE NULL 
  END,
  sent_at=CASE 
    WHEN reminder_log.last_error LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%' THEN reminder_log.sent_at
    ELSE NULL 
  END,
  updated_at=now()
WHERE reminder_log.status <> 'SENT'
  AND reminder_log.locked_at IS NULL
  AND reminder_log.scheduled_for IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.scheduled_for
RETURNING id AS reminder_id;

WITH candidates AS (
  SELECT rl.id
  FROM reminder_log rl
  JOIN appointments a ON a.id=rl.appointment_id
  WHERE rl.status='PENDING'
    AND rl.scheduled_for <= now()
    AND (rl.locked_at IS NULL OR rl.locked_at < now()-INTERVAL '30 minutes')
    AND (rl.last_error IS NULL OR (rl.updated_at <= now()-INTERVAL '5 minutes' AND rl.last_error NOT LIKE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED%'))
    AND a.status='SCHEDULED'
    AND a.starts_at > now()
  ORDER BY rl.scheduled_for ASC, rl.id ASC
  FOR UPDATE OF rl SKIP LOCKED
  LIMIT 100
)
UPDATE reminder_log rl
SET locked_at=now(), updated_at=now()
FROM candidates c
WHERE rl.id=c.id
RETURNING rl.id AS reminder_id, rl.appointment_id, rl.reminder_type,
          rl.scheduled_for, rl.locked_at AS claim_locked_at;

SELECT
  rl.id AS reminder_id,
  rl.appointment_id,
  rl.reminder_type,
  rl.scheduled_for,
  rl.locked_at AS claim_locked_at,
  a.status,
  a.starts_at,
  a.revision AS appointment_revision,
  p.full_name AS patient_name,
  p.whatsapp_phone,
  d.full_name AS doctor_name,
  d.timezone AS doctor_timezone,
  s.name AS service_name
FROM reminder_log rl
JOIN appointments a ON a.id=rl.appointment_id
JOIN patients p ON p.id=a.patient_id
JOIN doctors d ON d.id=a.doctor_id
JOIN services s ON s.id=a.service_id
WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
  AND rl.locked_at=$2::timestamptz
  AND rl.status='PENDING';

WITH current_state AS (
  SELECT rl.id, rl.status, rl.locked_at, a.status AS appointment_status,
         a.starts_at, a.revision, p.whatsapp_phone
  FROM reminder_log rl
  JOIN appointments a ON a.id=rl.appointment_id
  JOIN patients p ON p.id=a.patient_id
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
),
updated AS (
  UPDATE reminder_log rl
  SET status=CASE
        WHEN cs.appointment_status<>'SCHEDULED' THEN 'SKIPPED'
        WHEN cs.starts_at <= now() THEN 'SKIPPED'
        WHEN cs.whatsapp_phone IS NULL OR cs.whatsapp_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' THEN 'SKIPPED'
        WHEN cs.revision<>$3::integer THEN 'PENDING'
        ELSE 'SKIPPED'
      END,
      last_error=CASE
        WHEN cs.appointment_status<>'SCHEDULED' THEN 'Appointment is no longer SCHEDULED'
        WHEN cs.starts_at <= now() THEN 'Appointment is in the past'
        WHEN cs.whatsapp_phone IS NULL OR cs.whatsapp_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' THEN 'Invalid WhatsApp phone number'
        WHEN cs.revision<>$3::integer THEN 'Appointment changed during eligibility check; claim released'
        ELSE 'Appointment is not eligible for reminder delivery'
      END,
      locked_at=NULL,
      updated_at=now()
  FROM current_state cs
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
    AND rl.status='PENDING'
    AND rl.locked_at=$2::timestamptz
  RETURNING rl.id, rl.status
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT status FROM updated), 'CLAIM_LOST') AS result;

WITH current_state AS (
  SELECT rl.id AS reminder_id,
         rl.status AS reminder_status,
         rl.locked_at AS current_locked_at,
         rl.scheduled_for,
         rl.appointment_id,
         rl.reminder_type,
         rl.last_error,
         a.status AS appointment_status,
         a.starts_at,
         a.revision AS appointment_revision,
         p.full_name AS patient_name,
         p.whatsapp_phone,
         d.full_name AS doctor_name,
         d.timezone AS doctor_timezone,
         s.name AS service_name
  FROM reminder_log rl
  JOIN appointments a ON a.id=rl.appointment_id
  JOIN patients p ON p.id=a.patient_id
  JOIN doctors d ON d.id=a.doctor_id
  JOIN services s ON s.id=a.service_id
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
)
SELECT 
  cs.*,
  $2::timestamptz AS claim_locked_at,
  CASE
    WHEN cs.reminder_id IS NULL THEN 'CLAIM_LOST'
    WHEN cs.current_locked_at IS DISTINCT FROM $2::timestamptz THEN 'CLAIM_LOST'
    WHEN cs.last_error = 'IN_FLIGHT' THEN 'AMBIGUOUS'
    WHEN cs.reminder_status <> 'PENDING' THEN 'INVALID'
    WHEN cs.scheduled_for > now() THEN 'INVALID'
    WHEN cs.appointment_status <> 'SCHEDULED' THEN 'INVALID'
    WHEN cs.starts_at <= now() THEN 'INVALID'
    WHEN cs.appointment_revision <> $3::integer THEN 'INVALID'
    WHEN cs.whatsapp_phone IS NULL OR cs.whatsapp_phone !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' THEN 'INVALID'
    ELSE 'VALID'
  END AS validation_result
FROM (SELECT 1) dummy
LEFT JOIN current_state cs ON TRUE;

WITH current_appointment AS (
  SELECT a.status AS appointment_status, p.whatsapp_phone, a.starts_at
  FROM reminder_log rl
  JOIN appointments a ON a.id=rl.appointment_id
  JOIN patients p ON p.id=a.patient_id
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
)
UPDATE reminder_log
SET status = CASE 
               WHEN (SELECT appointment_status FROM current_appointment) <> 'SCHEDULED' THEN 'SKIPPED' 
               WHEN (SELECT starts_at FROM current_appointment) <= now() THEN 'SKIPPED'
               WHEN (SELECT whatsapp_phone FROM current_appointment) IS NULL OR (SELECT whatsapp_phone FROM current_appointment) !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' THEN 'SKIPPED'
               ELSE 'PENDING' 
             END,
    attempts = 0,
    last_error = CASE 
                   WHEN (SELECT appointment_status FROM current_appointment) <> 'SCHEDULED' THEN 'Appointment is no longer SCHEDULED; reminder skipped'
                   WHEN (SELECT starts_at FROM current_appointment) <= now() THEN 'Appointment is in the past; reminder skipped'
                   WHEN (SELECT whatsapp_phone FROM current_appointment) IS NULL OR (SELECT whatsapp_phone FROM current_appointment) !~ '^\+[1-9][0-9]{6,14}$' THEN 'Invalid WhatsApp phone number; reminder skipped'
                   ELSE 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: Appointment changed before reminder delivery'
                 END,
    locked_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='PENDING' AND locked_at=$2::timestamptz
RETURNING id AS reminder_id, status;

WITH marked_sent AS (
  UPDATE reminder_log rl
  SET status='SENT', sent_at=now(), last_error=NULL, locked_at=NULL, updated_at=now()
  FROM appointments a
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
    AND a.id=rl.appointment_id
    AND rl.status='PENDING'
    AND rl.locked_at=$2::timestamptz
    AND a.status='SCHEDULED'
    AND a.revision=$3::integer
  RETURNING rl.id
),
released AS (
  UPDATE reminder_log rl
  SET status=CASE WHEN a.status='SCHEDULED' THEN 'PENDING' ELSE 'SKIPPED' END,
      last_error=CASE
        WHEN a.status='SCHEDULED' THEN 'RECONCILIATION_REQUIRED: WhatsApp accepted before appointment revision changed'
        ELSE 'Appointment no longer SCHEDULED after WhatsApp delivery; reminder closed'
      END,
      locked_at=NULL,
      updated_at=now()
  FROM appointments a
  WHERE rl.id=$1::uuid
    AND a.id=rl.appointment_id
    AND rl.status='PENDING'
    AND rl.locked_at=$2::timestamptz
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked_sent)
  RETURNING rl.id, rl.status
)
SELECT 
  $1::uuid AS reminder_id,
  $4::uuid AS appointment_id,
  $5::text AS reminder_type,
  CASE
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM marked_sent) THEN 'SENT'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released WHERE status='SKIPPED') THEN 'SKIPPED_AFTER_ACCEPT'
    WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM released WHERE status='PENDING') THEN 'RELEASED_AFTER_ACCEPT'
    ELSE 'CLAIM_LOST'
  END AS finalize_result;

INSERT INTO audit_log (
  actor_type, action, entity_type, entity_id, metadata
)
VALUES (
  'SYSTEM',
  'REMINDER_WHATSAPP_ACCEPTED',
  'APPOINTMENT',
  $1::uuid,
  jsonb_build_object(
    'reminder_type',$2,
    'whatsapp_message_id',$3,
    'finalize_result',$4,
    'http_status',$5
  )
)
RETURNING id;

UPDATE reminder_log
SET status=CASE WHEN attempts+1>=5 THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END,
    attempts=attempts+1,
    last_error=$3,
    locked_at=NULL,
    updated_at=now()
WHERE id=$1::uuid AND status='PENDING' AND locked_at=$2::timestamptz
RETURNING id AS reminder_id,status,attempts;
